overview: This table controls which mission objective appears for each wave and how often, with story demos always using the first listed objective.
description: Per-wave mission-task lottery pools: ten candidate task ids paired with relative weights. The main battle paths (Arcade, Story battle and PvE) pick one weighted candidate per wave, while story-demo objective UI reads only the first candidate. The single exported asset has 134 rows.

Id.simple: The name a wave uses to find this group of possible objectives. Change it only if the wave is changed to match.
Id.technical: FName import key / DataTable row name for FGameDataTableRow_MissionTaskLottery (export field ID; all 134 keys match the ID value). MissionWave rows point to it with Id_MissionTaskLottery; 1768 non-None references across MissionWaveDataTable cover all 134 lottery rows. AGameDataTableManager loads the single MissionTaskLotteryDataTable asset through the DataTable primary-asset loader named by that row key into MissionTaskLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x9F0); once all loaders complete, null tables are filtered and StoryFindRowOutOfLine checks tables in order with bCheckNone=true, so a None id returns no row. No C++ consumer reads the row's Id member as data; an unreconstructed retail GetRows<MissionTaskLottery> collector (0x15B7FD0, HOLD) leaves another possible use unknown.

Id_MissionTask.simple: Possible objectives for this wave. One is picked by chance in Arcade, Story battles and computer-opponent missions, and story demos use the first.
Id_MissionTask.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. All 134 exported rows have 10 slots; unused slots are the FName string "None" and every exported row's first slot is non-None. BattleArcade_PickLotteryTask copies the array with Weights, removes None tasks together with the same-index weight, and returns Tasks[Picked] from the weighted pick; if the row is absent, all candidates are None, or either filtered array is empty, it returns NAME_None. The 150 distinct non-None ids all resolve in MissionTaskDataTable, and the picked id is looked up there (a missing/no pick leaves a None slot). Story_GetDemoMissionTask_13096F0 instead takes Id_MissionTask[0] when the array is non-empty, ignoring Weights and without filtering None; in the export that first slot is always a real task id.

Weights.simple: How likely each listed objective is to be picked in Arcade, Story battles and computer-opponent missions. Bigger numbers mean that objective appears more often.
Weights.technical: TArray<float>, default empty; all 134 exported rows have 10 values aligned with Id_MissionTask (106 rows are all 1.0; 28 use tiered values such as 80/40/40/20/20/...). BattleArcade_PickLotteryTask removes weights at filtered None slots, sums the survivors, draws StoryFRand() * Sum (StoryFRand is a uniform [0,1) float from GameDataTableManager_RandRange(0, MAX_int32)), and BattleArcade_PickWeightIndex returns the first index whose interval contains the roll, falling back to the last index if the walk exhausts the array. An empty pool returns NAME_None. Weights are relative totals, not probabilities (row sums often exceed 1), and must stay index-aligned with Id_MissionTask; the export has no zero/negative weights, but the runtime picker does not reject them.

notes: Single export shard: JJKCCDatatables/datatables/MissionTaskLotteryDataTable.json has 134 rows in one variant, with no localized or numbered shards; the retail registry has only /Game/DataTables/MissionTaskLotteryDataTable (Tools/verify/M4-mount/registry-summary.json). Row keys are unique and equal the exported ID, all 134 are referenced by MissionWaveDataTable, and all 150 distinct non-None task ids resolve in MissionTaskDataTable.

Lookup/cache chain: the DataTable primary asset named MissionTaskLotteryDataTable is loaded into MissionTaskLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x9F0) after every loader completes (GameDataTableManager.cpp:289,462; GameDataTableManager.h:200). All three weighted battle paths call BattleArcade_PickLotteryTask: Arcade setup (GamePhase_BattleArcade.cpp:157), Story battle setup (GamePhase_BattleStory.cpp:198) and PvE wave task generation (GamePvESettings.cpp:674). PvE caches the picked ids in FGamePvESettings::MissionTaskIds (GamePhase_IntervalPvE.cpp:972,1013), which PvE battle phases resolve through MissionTaskDataTables (GamePhase_BattlePvESolo.cpp:494, GamePhase_BattlePvETag.cpp:69). The story-demo objective path bypasses weighting and takes element 0 (StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:568-571).

Evidence strength: current status/functions.json reports weighted picker 0x1302490 as state match (MATCH verdict) and finder 0x12fb0a0 as behavioural/BEHAV-certified, i.e. reconstructed behaviour rather than byte-identical code; older DIFF lane rows for the finder remain in status/verdicts.json. Retail also has a FGameDataTableArray::GetRows<FGameDataTableRow_MissionTaskLottery> collector at 0x15B7FD0 (state HOLD) called from an unreconstructed body at 0x15BABBF; its purpose is unknown.

Retail Blueprint/cooked-asset behaviour was not inspected; the checkout's Content is partial, so no claim about Blueprint-only readers is made. All consumer statements above come from reconstructed C++ and serialized export data.

usages.detail: Caches the loaded MissionTaskLotteryDataTable UDataTable in MissionTaskLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x9F0) once all DataTable loaders have completed; null tables are filtered.
Adds MissionTaskLotteryDataTable to the DataTable primary asset loader name list, which becomes the loader map alias used by the manager.

BattleArcade_PickLotteryTask resolves the row with bCheckNone=true, drops None tasks with their same-index weights, and performs the weighted pick with StoryFRand() times the weight sum; missing row or empty pool returns NAME_None.
Arcade wave setup picks one task id per wave and resolves it in MissionTaskDataTables before passing the task array to SetupArcadeMission.
Story battle wave setup uses the same weighted picker and resolves the picked id into the task array for SetupStoryMission.
GamePvE_MakeMissionTasks uses the same picker for each selected wave, leaving None in output slots where no wave row or pick exists.
Stores the picked task ids in FGamePvESettings::MissionTaskIds and forwards them in the interval parameter (line 1013).
PvE battle resolves cached MissionTaskIds through MissionTaskDataTables with bCheckNone=true.
PvE tag battle resolves the same cached MissionTaskIds through MissionTaskDataTables.
Story-demo objective lookup resolves the lottery row and reads only Id_MissionTask[0], ignoring Weights.
Explicit out-of-line row finder instantiation for this row struct at retail 0x12FB0A0, used by the weighted picker and the story-demo helper.
